newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian public works minister dies at 57.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian public works minister dies at 57.

text.p: Egypt's Public Works and Water Resources Minister Abdel Hadi Radi died in hospital on Wednesday, hospital officials said. He was 57.
Officials at EgyptAir International Hospital said Radi was admitted into intensive care on Tuesday with severe anaemia.
Doctors said the cause of death was acute heart failure and he had also been suffering from a colon disease.
Egyptian newspapers and officials have said that Radi had cancer of the colon and often flew abroad for treatment. During public appearances, he appeared frail and very ill.
Radi was a veteran member of Egypt's cabinet.
